about: Points (#89; scope-v1 module 9; question #395, decision 0161). A member earns points for a visit when it closes, on two schemes at once. Hours by stake: each table type's points an hour (points.per_hour) for the seconds played there, rounded down to a whole point. Time played is the call-time clock's: seating to leaving, less time away; a session that moved tables shares its played time among them in proportion to the time at each, rounded down to the second. RIVR Rewards: each hand's rake is shared equally among the members seated at its table, rounded down to the paisa; the member earns a share (points.rewards_rake_share, 500 basis points is 5%) of their rake for the visit as points, one a rupee, rounded down. Points never convert to cash.

cases.description: Three hours at 100/200, ten points an hour: 30 points.
Two hours 59 minutes at ten an hour is 29.83 points: rounded down to 29.
Exactly six minutes at ten an hour: one whole point.
A second short of six minutes at ten an hour: no point yet.
Four hours 50 minutes in the Private Room at twenty an hour is 96.67 points: 96.
A table type with no rate earns nothing, however long the session.
No time played: nothing.
No move: two hours at one table with 20 minutes away is 100 minutes played there.
Moved after an hour of a three-hour session with 30 minutes away: the first table gets a third of the 2 h 30 min played, 50 minutes.
The same session's second table gets the other two thirds, 100 minutes: the two add up to the time played.
A third of 2,000 seconds is 666.67: rounded down to 666 (the other table's 1,333.33 to 1,333, a second lost).
A session that ended as it began: nothing played anywhere.
₹300 of rake among six seated: ₹50 each.
₹350 among nine is ₹38.888...: rounded down to ₹38.88.
Heads up in the Private Room at the ₹12,000 cap, one member seated: all of it.
A hand with no rake: nothing to share.
A visit's rake share of ₹612.40 at 5%: ₹30.62, so 30 points.
₹20 of rake at 5% is exactly ₹1: one point.
A paisa short, ₹19.99 at 5%: no point.
A big night, ₹1,00,000 of rake at 5%: 5,000 points.
No rake share: no points.
